Is an electric car worth it?

How many kilometres a year you need for an electric car to be cheaper than a petrol or hybrid.

How it works

We compare the total cost of both cars for each annual mileage and find the point where the electric one becomes cheaper. It doesn't include incentives such as Plan Auto+, which would bring that point forward.
